dashboard.label: TA-devfleet Overview
dashboard.description: Collects a PCI/USB device inventory signature (count + MD5 of the sorted device list via lspci/lsusb) and reports new or removed devices versus the previous cycle using a local

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-devfleet" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-devfleet. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-devfleet requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-devfleet", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-devfleet/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("devfleet.pci_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("devfleet.usb_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="devfleet:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | spath input=_raw output=n path=device_delta | stats sum(n) as value

panel.title: Newly seen devices (appears when inventory changed)
panel.description: Rows appear only on cycles where the device inventory changed (status=alarm).

search.query: index=main sourcetype="devfleet:status" status="alarm" | spath input=_raw output=x path=new_devices{} | where isnotnull(x) AND x!="" | mvexpand x | rename x as "device" | table host "device"

panel.title: Removed devices (appears when inventory changed)
panel.description: Rows appear only on cycles where the device inventory changed (status=alarm).

search.query: index=main sourcetype="devfleet:status" status="alarm" | spath input=_raw output=x path=removed_devices{} | where isnotnull(x) AND x!="" | mvexpand x | rename x as "device" | table host "device"
index=main sourcetype="devfleet:status" | dedup host | table host pci_count usb_count pci_signature usb_signature
